description.en: Local official agy ACP adapter reusing the existing CLI login. Every model request is rerouted through a loopback sanitizing gateway that strips non-DSH tool declarations and rewrites the system prompt; malformed requests are never forwarded. Text and image input both pass through, and an upstream refusal is reported as an explicit error instead of a fake answer.
description.zh: 复用本机官方 agy 登录的 ACP 模型适配器。所有模型请求改道本机净化网关：删除非 DSH 工具声明、重写系统提示，解析失败即拒绝转发。文本与图片均可直传，上游拒绝（如 429）会明确报错而不是变成假回答。
